game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Cinder Cone Camp Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before ash wraiths spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: In Cinder Cone Camp, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before ash wraiths spring the trap. Each round, ash wraiths strike the cooling vent, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the predictions value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the cooling vent from ash wraiths in Cinder Cone Camp: keep the predictions meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: predictions drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ash wraiths in Cinder Cone Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while predictions > 0.
